title: Oil Fuels - Viscosities vs. Temperatures
description: Viscosities of fuel oils vs. temperature. Saybolt Universal Seconds (SSU) - kinematic viscosity versus temperature for typical fuel oils.

components.content:
## Key Information

- **Temperature Conversion**: TF = TC × 9/5 + 32
- **Viscosity Conversion**: SSU (Saybolt Universal Seconds) ≈ centiStokes (cSt) × 4.55
  - *Note: This equation is approximate and valid only for a specific range of viscosities. For more accurate conversions, refer to ASTM D2161.*
- **Pumping Limit**: 4 - 5000 SSU is the maximum practical limit for pumping
- **Atomization Range**: 150 - 300 SSU for fuel oil no. 5 and 6
